title: Hi! I'm Emily
content-en: I’m a UI/UX Designer committed to communicative with team members to solve problems and handling design projects with excellent collaborative efforts. In addition to UIUX, I have been exposed to different fields such as front-end develop, industrial design, 3D printing etc.I hope to provide every user with better experiences and look to learn new things everyday.
content-ch: 從事UI/UX Designer約五年多，參與超過10項專案，重視與團隊成員的溝通協作，致力於透過設計解決問題。除了 UI/UX 設計以外，也曾接觸過前端開發、工業設計、3D 列印等領域，期望透過多元經驗，為使用者打造更好的體驗。
